programs.title: Incas: The Rise and Fall
programs.desc:
The origins of the emergence of an advanced ancient civilization in South America.According to Inca mythology, the legendary founder of the Inca dynasty and the city of Cuzco is Manco Capac.An equally important figure was Pachacutec, one of the most distinguished rulers.It was during his reign that Machu Picchu was created.Thanks to conquests, reforms, revolutionizing architecture and infrastructure development, he transformed his kingdom into a powerful empire.He imposed a solar cult, establishing a sun festival.To maintain his power, he did not hesitate to perform human sacrifices
A hundred years - that's how long it took the Incas to build many monumental buildings.The secrets of this rapid expansion remained a mystery for centuries.The greatest conquests of the empire are due to Tupac Yupanqui, who achieved them thanks to alliances.He defeated rivals along the Pacific coast.He ruled the empire from Cuzco.It was supported by an impressive 40,000 kilometers of roads, power centers, and a node-based counting system.The creators of the documentary will present this rapid expansion of the Empire of the Sun recreated in 3D, from Cuzco, through the coast, to the Atacama Desert.
